dct_description_sm: Collection of Quttinirpaaq National Park Arctic char and associated data to assess: 1. population structure, genetic and morphological variation and variation in the dynamics of Arctic char populations; 2. stable isotope analysis of food web relationships of Arctic char; 3. contaminants analysis of food web relationships of Arctic char; 4. development of a data base for long-term archival of information for Arctic char populations in the Park.
dct_title_s: Climate Variability and Change (CVC) Effects on Char in the Arctic - Assessment of the Arctic char of Quttinirpaaq National Park, Ellesmere Island, Nunavut
